title: Spectral Geometry and Cyclic Homology of $SU_q(2)$
exact_target: Complete the geometric, index, differential, metric, and equivariant homology interpretation of the spectral data of the deformed special unitary group.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000344 (OWR-1109-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Noncommutative Geometry and Quantum Field Theory (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/48, pp. 2705--2760; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 44--45, printed pages 2748--2749.

status_qualification: Keep all bundled questions: Paschke duality and K_q; orientation; a canonical local-index cocycle; differential calculus and Dirac-operator freedom; equivariant cyclic theory. The source also asks to understand a suitable smooth algebra and calculate its cyclic homology. These are distinct requirements, not one interchangeable index computation.
